explanation: Legacy model (pro.incidencias + broki.html) does not use a separate messages entity. UI builds messages[] from descripcion/defect/message fields or client-side memory; n8n may insert additional incidencias rows (estado updates) as history, not child messages. broki_incident_messages is a Broki-native table seeded for demos; normalize_incidents never writes to it. Not a migration loss of a legacy messages table.
note_html: public_html/broki.html processIncidents constructs msgs from descripcion; treats multiple rows per id_objeto as current/history, not broki_incident_messages
